label: Vossmark Grunt -- Polish Pass (v2)
note: Baseline trooper, light polish only: the mouth was a 7px-wide solid white block reading as a cartoon grin, narrowed to a 3px closed stern line. Silhouette otherwise kept as the Vossmark family baseline that Quota Enforcer and Riot Enforcer differentiate from.

label: Quota Enforcer -- Distinct Silhouette (v1)
note: Was sharing the Grunt's full soldier shape. Redesigned as a corporate labor-enforcer, not a soldier: bare head (no helmet), visible unshadowed face, a lighter vest instead of plate armor, narrower silhouette overall -- still carries the established baton. Self-caught and fixed a missing-arm bug before presenting: the raised baton-hand had a 5-row gap with nothing connecting it to the shoulder (same category of bug as Merc's original missing arm).

label: Riot Enforcer -- Distinct Silhouette (v1)
note: Was sharing the Grunt's shape. Redesigned as the bulkiest of the three: full face-shield helmet (no visible face at all), a riot shield on one arm, baton on the other, wider shoulders, shin guards. Self-caught a subtler bug: the shield and baton each had their own full outline touching the torso's outline, and two adjacent near-black outline pixels read as a background gap at this scale even with no actual transparent dot between them -- merged them into shared single boundaries instead.

label: Talos Wraith -- Bespoke Silhouette (v1)
note: Was sharing stealthHumanoid with Phantom. Anchored to the Warhammer 40k 'Genestealer Hybrid' archetype per the design doc's own retcon framing (Security Wing = 'closer to human, soldier-shaped', contrasted against the overtly monstrous Specimen Wing) -- so kept mostly human-soldier-shaped and pushed the mutation into one tell: a fused venom-glow claw growing out of the forearm (not held, avoids the floating-prop failure mode that hit Merc/Officer twice already) instead of a hand. Ragged/uneven cowl hem (vs. a clean cloth edge), hunched asymmetric stance (one arm tucked, implies compact/fast). Self-QA against a light-bg render caught a real bug: the original palette had almost no value spread between outline/hood/body, so the whole thing read as a flat near-black blob with two eye-dots -- fixed by widening the brightness range and giving the claw a genuinely contrasting venom-green accent instead of a same-family near-miss color. Also dropped a stray 'tucked hand' pixel that read as a rendering error.

label: Talos Phantom -- Bespoke Silhouette (v1)
note: Was sharing stealthHumanoid with Wraith. First pass (v2) kept Wraith's exact proportions and only changed color + a brow-ridge detail -- self-QA caught that this violated the session's own 'distinct silhouette per tier, not a pure recolor' rule, confirmed by a light-bg render that showed basically the same rectangle as Wraith. Reworked (v3) with real geometry differences: an angular chitin crest (vs. Wraith's rounded ragged hood), a tapered waist (sleeker/upright vs. Wraith's hunched block), and the fused blade held up in a forward lunge at shoulder height (vs. Wraith's blade tucked at the hip) which changes the actual bounding-box silhouette, not just the color. Cooler/brighter cyan family for the 'more composed, trained operative' read one step up from Wraith.

label: Talos Vanguard -- Bespoke 24x32 (v3)
note: Was sharing humanoidOfficer with the (now-split-off) Vossmark Officer -- last unit still on that shared shape. User feedback on v1: Phantom was the best of the three, Wraith was fine, Vanguard 'needs the most work' -- it read as a flat monochrome-maroon rectangle with a blade that floated beside the body with no visible grip. v3 fixes: the plasma blade now has a pointed tip and a real crossguard + gripping hand at the bottom (bridges torso and blade so it reads as HELD, not floating); an asymmetric chitin spike off the left shoulder breaks the same-rounded-head silhouette Wraith/Phantom share; a hidden second clawed limb peeks from under the coat at the hip (venom-green, same accent as Wraith's claw) -- a direct callback to the Genestealer-hybrid research anchor ('may hide an extra clawed limb under tattered clothes') that also breaks the all-maroon monochrome with a second color; and a glowing bio-crack runs through the chest banding, tying toward the Specimen Wing's bio-horror without leaving 'soldier-shaped'. Also added a glowing throat-node (2.0x-weak-Psionic tell, front-facing analogue of Erebus Shaman's antennae) and Broodmarshal-family ribbed chitin banding down the torso, both kept from v1.

label: [STASHED] Cyborg Gunner — bionic-arm mob idea
note: Not an active candidate -- salvaged from a rejected Merc rifle-arm redesign that read as a bionic/prosthetic arm rather than a held rifle (gunmetal fused directly into the shoulder/arm as one continuous limb). That failure mode is exactly the right READ for a cyborg mob. Revisit when doing mob work; needs a new palette/nature (synthetic augmented-human) and probably a new mob-scale shape, not literally this hero-scale grid.
